cues.text: Here's our table, units already set. Let's give it real materials.
On the Materials tab, New Wood opens a procedural wood material.
The editor previews the material as you adjust it. Save adds it to the project.
Select the table top, then choose Apply Material.
Ooh, look at that grain! Materials belong to each instance, so select all four legs.
Nice. For the ground, snap a large rectangle around the table.
New Grass grows real blades on whatever surface it's applied to.
Set the blade height and density here, then Save.
Wooow, real grass! Materials are saved with the project, editable at any time.
